content.text:
## Overall verdict

The **P0 execution-truth foundation is largely landed** in the existing `paper_*` / `execution` stack (not a separate `services/automated_trading/` package). **P1 code exists**; **P2 is a partial Paper Console panel**; **P3 was not started**. Branch: `codex/testnet-truth-recovery`.

Open git diff on `account_equity.py` is **related equity-sync hardening**, not a core checklist item.

---

## P0.0 — Foundations

| Item | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **ADR-078** | **EXISTS** | `C:\Users\win\Desktop\AI--main\.github\agent\memory\decisions-log.md` (lines ~663–670). Accepted; “staged migration in progress”. |
| **Diagnostic scripts → USDT-M Testnet gateway (not spot)** | **EXISTS** | Explicit USDT-M gateway: `scripts\check_binance_positions.py` (`BinanceUsdtPerpetualGateway`, `source: BINANCE_USDT_M_TESTNET`, safety: testnet on / live off). Also: `scripts\capture_testnet_truth_bundle.py`, `scripts\testnet_preflight.py` (futures probe via `probe_testnet_account`), `scripts\check_execution_blockers.py`, `scripts\flatten_binance_sim_account.py`, `scripts\prove_real_binance_natural_order.py`. Spot keys appear only as a separate readiness flag in preflight, not as the futures diagnostic path. |
| **Scheduler heartbeat offline logic** | **EXISTS** | `services\execution\runtime_state.py`: missing → `scheduler_heartbeat_missing`; age > 120s → `scheduler_heartbeat_stale` (returns offline-style state). Wired into Runtime snapshot as unavailable when not `running`. Tests: `tests\services\test_runtime_scheduler.py`, `tests\services\test_execution_blockers_script.py`. Writers: `services\execution\scheduler.py`, `scheduler_coordination.py`. |
| **LEGACY_UNVERIFIED migration** | **EXISTS** | `migrations\versions\0014_exchange_truth_foundation.py` UPDATE: `MANAGED_STRATEGY` → `LEGACY_UNVERIFIED` when `entry_fill_receipt_id` or `position_group_id` is NULL. Enum: `shared\models\workflow.py` (`PositionManagementStatus.LEGACY_UNVERIFIED`). Runtime use: `services\execution\paper_exchange_execution.py`. Follow-on: `migrations\versions\0015_unique_open_managed_position.py`. |

---

## P0.1 — Execution truth

| Item | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **ExecutionMode (LOCAL_PAPER, BINANCE_TESTNET)** | **EXISTS** | `shared\models\execution_truth.py`: enum names `LOCAL_PAPER` / `BINANCE_TESTNET`, values `local_paper` / `binance_testnet`. Resolver + legacy map: `services\execution\execution_truth.py`. Tests: `tests\services\test_exchange_truth_contract.py`. |
| **Order state machine** | **EXISTS** | `ExchangeOrderState` in `shared\models\execution_truth.py` (`INTENT_CREATED` … `CLOSED`, including `EXCHANGE_UNKNOWN`, `EMERGENCY_CLOSE_PENDING`, `DUST_REMAINS`). Transitions driven in `services\execution\paper_exchange_execution.py`. |
| **exchange_orders / exchange_fill_receipts** | **EXISTS** | Migration `0014`; ORM `services\strategy_library\models.py`; repo methods in `services\strategy_library\repository.py`; API list in `apps\api\routers\runtime.py`. |
| **ensure_binance_execution → EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE** | **EXISTS** | `PaperExchangeExecutionService.ensure_binance_execution` in `services\execution\paper_exchange_execution.py` (~1122–1153): gateway None → `gateway_status="EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE"`, `execution_status="EXCHANGE_UNKNOWN"`. Test asserts this in `tests\services\test_exchange_truth_contract.py`. |
| **PretradeMarketSnapshot** | **EXISTS** | Model: `shared\models\execution_truth.py`. Builder: `BinanceUsdtPerpetualGateway.pretrade_market_snapshot` in `services\execution\gateway.py` (USDT-M book/mark). Validator: `validate_pretrade_snapshot` in `services\execution\execution_truth.py`. Test: `tests\services\test_binance_gateway.py`. |
| **CloseOnly dust** | **EXISTS** | `close_quantity()` rounds **down**, never inflates to min notional (`services\execution\execution_truth.py`). Close path uses it in `paper_exchange_execution.gateway_order_request`. Post-close → `DUST_REMAINS`. Tests: `test_close_quantity_never_rounds_up_to_min_notional`, DUST assertions in `test_exchange_truth_contract.py`. Entry path still may bump to min notional (by design). |
| **Protection escalation** | **EXISTS (core) / PARTIAL vs plan prose** | Gateway: 2 protection attempts → emergency reduce-only compensate → `emergency_close_failed` (`services\execution\gateway.py` ~720–769). Escalation to `EMERGENCY_CLOSE_PENDING` + entry kill switch in `paper_exchange_execution.py`. ACTIVE requires exchange protection IDs (ADR-078 + protection column adds in `0014`). Full plan §7.4/§7.5 race matrix not necessarily exhaustively coded as a separate protection FSM. |
| **suppress(Exception) removal** | **PARTIAL** | Plan forbids silent `suppress(Exception)`. Still present in trading-adjacent code: `services\execution\gateway.py` (several), `services\execution\paper_cycle_orchestrator.py` (~1717 strategy writeback), `services\execution\testnet_acceptance.py`. Narrower suppresses (`TypeError`/`ValueError`) also remain in pretrade snapshot. |

---

## P0.2 — Observability

|---|---|---|

| **RuntimeDatum** | **EXISTS** | `shared\models\execution_truth.py`; used throughout `apps\api\routers\runtime.py` (`_datum`). |
| **/api/v1/runtime/\*** | **EXISTS** | Router `apps\api\routers\runtime.py` mounted in `apps\api\main.py` under `/api/v1`: `/snapshot`, `/decisions`, `/exchange-orders`, `/positions`, `/llm-invocations`, `/reconciliation`, WS `/events`. |
| **WS events** | **EXISTS** | `@router.websocket("/events")` pushes `runtime_truth` every 5s (decisions, orders, receipts, protections, llm). Frontend: `frontend\admin\src\hooks\useRuntimeTruth.js` → `streamUrl("/api/v1/runtime/events")`. |

---

Tests: `tests\services\test_directional_sampling_fallback.py`, `tests\services\test_paper_runtime.py`. Not the plan’s greenfield `services/automated_trading/...` package (that path is **MISSING**). Task history still says natural Entry→Fill→Exit receipt proof for P0.3 is incomplete. |

---

| **smoke_llm_provider.py** | **EXISTS** | `scripts\smoke_llm_provider.py` — one smoke call, journals to `llm_invocations`, preflights DB, never trades. Task history notes first live smoke failed on DB host before journal fix; a successful paid smoke may still be unverified. |

What exists: `RuntimeTruthPanel.jsx` (“为什么没有交易”) on `PaperConsole.jsx`, plus `useRuntimeTruth.js` calling runtime APIs. Covers Why-No-Trade + basic Testnet/Scheduler/AI snippets, not the full Overview product surface. |

---

## P3 — Strategy evidence upgrades

| Item | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **Strategy evidence upgrades** | **MISSING** | `.github\agent\memory\task-history.md` (2026-07-27): “P3 strategy-evidence upgrades were not started.” Pre-existing promotion/OOS gates (`ValidationAdmissionService`, etc.) are older work, not this authenticity-plan P3 package. |

---

## Git: `account_equity.py` / tests

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Modified only those two files on `codex/testnet-truth-recovery` |
| **What** | After a successful `gateway.sync_account`, reuse that equity and set `prefer_exchange=False` on the follow-up resolve so the private API is not called twice in one cycle. Tests assert `sync_account_calls == 1` and `account_equity_calls == 0`. |
| **Relation** | **Related** to Testnet equity truth / gateway load, **orthogonal** to ADR-078 tables, funnel, sampling, runtime UI, and LLM smoke. |

---

## Scoreboard (implementation vs plan package)

| Phase | Verdict |
|---|---|
| **P0.0** | **EXISTS** (all four sub-items) |
| **P0.1** | **EXISTS** core; **PARTIAL** on blanket `suppress(Exception)` purge |
| **P0.2** | **EXISTS** |
| **P0.3** | **EXISTS** lane tagging/limits; lifecycle proof still open |
| **P1** | **EXISTS** (code); live smoke success may be unverified |
| **P2** | **PARTIAL** |
| **P3** | **MISSING** |

**Architecture note:** The rebuild plan’s `services/automated_trading/` and frontend `AutomatedTrading/` packages were **not** created; equivalent behavior was grafted onto the legacy Paper/execution path, which matches ADR-078’s “staged migration” language.
